create_raw_data_pipeline: create a raw data pipeline from a manifest TSV file to load audio and optional text transcriptions
discover_splits: discover dataset splits by scanning a directory for TSV manifest files and returning split names
retrieve_audio_directory: retrieve the audio directory path from the header line of a manifest TSV file
read_tsv_file: read a TSV manifest file and build a data pipeline with audio paths and sample lengths
read_wrd_file: read a WRD transcription file and build a data pipeline returning text entries
